precondition: Same password-verified identity/session owns live enrollment A.
obligation: Replacement requires A and returns B. Atomically invalidate A; A cannot confirm. Only matching live B plus valid proof verifies MFA and issues codes once. The setup URI/manual key must describe B, not A.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: Live matching B; well-shaped but incorrect OTP.
obligation: Reject proof without verified MFA or code issuance; maintain restricted session.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: Live matching B; proof is outside server-approved authenticator time window.
obligation: Reject expired proof; preparation and browser acknowledgment do not establish verification.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: Server expiry has passed for B.
obligation: Return 409 before evaluating proof; no verification or codes; server controls expiry.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: Identifier B belongs to a different identity OR a different session of the same identity.
obligation: Never select another identity using the identifier. Return the same 409 as missing/stale enrollment without existence disclosure.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: B was replaced, consumed or revoked.
obligation: Never verify or reissue codes from stale/consumed enrollment, even with correct proof. Concurrent confirmation has at most one successful issuance.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: Rate limit reached under server-approved policy.
obligation: Return 429 and positive Retry-After with no verification/issuance; no automatic retry. Numeric fixture delay is synthetic.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: Password verified, required MFA not yet satisfied.
obligation: Preparation or copy/download acknowledgment cannot grant chapter/context/duty/provider access. Protected chapter operation lookup returns 403 without record data. Authenticated authority is recomputed after proof, never supplied by a caller flag.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: Confirmation may have committed but its response was lost/malformed.
obligation: Explicit GET bootstrap determines current authentication state only. Never automatically repeat confirmation or restart enrollment. Verified session does not promise code readback; ticket 04 owns explicit protected regeneration with fresh proof. Challenge requires existing proof; enrollment pending needs reviewed next action, not inference of rejection. Signed out requires sign-in. With no usable factor, assisted recovery remains blocked pending an approved procedure. No recovery restores extra authority.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.

precondition: User navigates away, expires, signs out or completes confirmation.
obligation: Keep secrets transient; clear on lifecycle changes, never store passwords/OTPs/enrollment material/codes as editable drafts or durable browser state. Only preparation 200 returns setup material; only successful confirmation 200 returns initial codes. An explicit user export is a secret copy, never a persisted browser draft.
limitations: Exchange schemas and generated consumer are executed; server effects, authorization, expiry, binding, code consumption and persistence are not.
